verdict.rationale: IRCC offers an online application-status check and account services, so programmatic event notifications such as status-change webhooks are a fair question for a service like this. However, nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or any event subscription mechanism. The status checker and processing-times tool are web pages a user visits, not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
